summary: E2E verification of Revenue → Transactions symbol drill-down feature. All 10 new backend pytest cases pass; all 11 review scenarios verified via Playwright. Clicking a By-Symbol row on /revenue navigates to /transactions?symbol=XXX; symbol chip with coin icon, X-clear, back button, deep-link and filter-pill narrowing all work; TradingPair pair-revenue banner renders correctly. No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: Transactions.jsx already trims symbol via toUpperCase() on client and backend does symbol.upper() — consistent, good.

TradingPair.jsx is now ~1000 lines and growing — consider splitting into Position/Strategy/Events subcomponents to keep it maintainable (previous iteration flagged server.py; frontend is trending the same way).
Revenue.jsx uses inline arrow onClick with navigate() — fine; consider memoising by_symbol rows if list grows large.
PageHeader now supports onBack correctly and defaults to nav(-1) — good backward compatibility.
seed_data_creation: Admin already had SELL history for BTCUSDT/SOLUSDT/XRPUSDT (from previous session). Pytest fixture seeds an extra profitable BTCUSDT SELL to guarantee non-empty data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Drill-down feature verified end-to-end. Key data-testids: revenue-symbol-<SYM>, symbol-filter-active, clear-symbol-filter, back-btn (in PageHeader when showBack), tx-row-<id>, tx-list, empty-tx, filter-ALL/BUY/SELL, pair-today-profit, pair-cum-profit. Backend endpoints: GET /api/transactions?symbol=XXX (case-insensitive, uppercases via .upper()), GET /api/revenue/pair/{symbol}. Note: Playwright wait after page.goto to /transactions must wait for tx-list and add ~1-2s for the /transactions fetch to resolve before asserting row count; symbol-filter-active becomes visible before rows load.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified. Initial false negative on deep-link (0 rows) during Playwright was due to insufficient wait after page.goto; retry with wait_for_selector on tx-list + 2.5s buffer confirmed 10 rows loaded, chip shows '10 trades · +$129.64 profit', BUY-pill=7 rows, SELL-pill=3 rows.
